title: Findings File
description: The shared machine-readable findings.json (repo root) that AI-assisted planning, coding, and testing work in this repo appends to, keyed by finding id, so a later session can pick up open side-effects instead of re-discovering them. During implementation, anything noticed that is out of scope for the current session (a side-effect, an unrelated defect, a follow-up) is recorded here rather than fixed inline — see CLAUDE.md -> 'Findings file'. This file is committed to a PUBLIC repo: no finding may contain secrets, credentials, AWS account IDs or ARNs, or internal-only URLs/hostnames — describe the shape of an issue and reference code by path/line, never paste sensitive values. Restricted to the JSON Schema subset Claude's Structured Outputs supports, so an agent can be constrained to this schema directly via output_config.format / messages.parse() when producing a finding.

schemaVersion.description: Stable schema version. Bump only on breaking changes to this contract.

id.description: Stable, unique key for this finding across appends and status updates (dedupe key). Convention: producer + a short kebab-case slug (e.g. 'qa-jest-configloader-yaml-parse') — no counter. Pick a slug and check for an existing collision before writing; don't rely on reading the whole file for a 'next' value.

component.description: Ownership axis — the two published packages in packages/@cdklabs/ (see CLAUDE.md -> 'Toolchain'), plus 'shared' for findings that genuinely span more than one (e.g. a type exported by cdk-cicd-wrapper and consumed by the CLI, or the register hook contract the CLI's exec depends on). Findings about process, tooling, samples, or docs that aren't about a specific package (e.g. this schema file, projen config, the test harness) go under 'infra'. 'wrapper' = @cdklabs/cdk-cicd-wrapper (the jsii constructs library). 'cli' = @cdklabs/cdk-cicd-wrapper-cli. There was a third value, 'projen' (@cdklabs/cdk-cicd-wrapper-projen); v3 removed that package (task.md D5, consolidation 3→2) and no finding used the value, so it was retired with it.

layer.description: Detection axis, kept tool-agnostic so new checks don't need a new value: 'static' = found without executing anything (eslint/tsc, jsii compile, 'npx projen compat', security-review/code-review skill output, design/planning discussion). 'dynamic' = found by executing code outside production (today: jest unit tests, and the real-AWS deploy harness in task.md Phase 0; tomorrow: any other test framework). 'production' = surfaced by observing a live environment (monitoring, alarms, a real incident) — no current producer emits this; reserved for that future case.

producer.description: What emitted the finding, named for the durable role rather than today's specific tool so the value survives past any one effort. 'qa' = jest (each package's test/**) or the real-AWS deploy harness failures/gaps. 'code-review' = the security-review or code-review skill run against pending changes. 'migration' = gaps found while carrying out whichever large structural migration is currently underway — today, the v2->v3 rework (see docs/design/v3-devops-experience.md, task.md); update this description, not the enum value, when a different migration takes its place. 'planning' = design/spec gaps surfaced before implementation starts (design-doc authoring, a grilling session, resolving a task.md D<n> decision).

severity.description: high is worth resolving before merging the related change; medium/low are advisory. Not currently enforced by any gate — this repo has no CI check reading this file, so treat 'high' as a strong signal for whoever reads it next, not a merge block.

status.description: open until an agent or developer resolves it. Flip in place to resolved (or wontfix) rather than deleting the entry, so history stays visible.

title.description: Human-facing one-line summary (a sentence, not the id slug).

location.description: Optional file/resource this finding anchors to.

lens.description: Only meaningful for producer=code-review: which review skill raised it. Not schema-enforced against producer (conditional keywords are outside the Structured Outputs subset) — leave unset for every other producer.
